title: Charge spectral support is invariant under the completed local and fixed-sector global flows

spectral_invariance.projectors: For every Borel set B in the spectrum of the self-adjoint compact generator Q, P_B=1_B(Q) commutes with Q, every spacetime derivative, D_A and the scalar multiplier f(||phi||^2).
spectral_invariance.projected_equation: P_B phi solves the same linear covariant equation D_mu D^mu(P_B phi)+(m^2+mu Q^2+f(||phi||^2))P_B phi=0 in the common background A and scalar coefficient f.
spectral_invariance.zero_data_uniqueness: If P_B phi and P_B pi vanish initially, uniqueness for the bounded-sector approximants and the K1392 completed local limit makes them vanish throughout the solution interval.
spectral_invariance.support_statement: The essential Q-spectral support of the matter Cauchy pair is time invariant; the radial nonlinearity and the shared Maxwell field exchange energy but create no new charge labels.
spectral_invariance.cutoff_compatibility: Every P_N sector is invariant, and if M<=N then the P_N solution from P_M-supported data equals the P_M solution by uniqueness.
spectral_invariance.gauge_compatibility: Admissible gauge transformations exp(i alpha Q) commute with every P_B, so spectral support is independent of the admitted gauge representative.
spectral_invariance.boundary: Support invariance is a kinematic decomposition theorem. It does not bound the energy carried at large charge, make the fixed-sector estimates cutoff uniform or select Q physically.
